## Complete Project Catalog

### 1. Kiska Kitna Hisab — Group Expense Tracker & Instant UPI Settlement
- **Live URL**: https://kiskakitnahisab.netlify.app/
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/Himanshu4234
- **Type**: Web Application (FinTech / Group Finance)
- **Status**: Production / Live
- **Summary**: An intuitive full-stack expense manager inspired by Splitwise, built specifically for the Indian payments ecosystem with direct UPI QR code and deep-link generation.
- **Key Architecture & Features**:
  - Supabase PostgreSQL database with Row Level Security (RLS) policies for encrypted per-group transactions.
  - Greedy debt simplification algorithm minimizing settlement cashflows across group members.
  - 1-click dynamic UPI payment links and printable QR codes supporting Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm, and BHIM UPI.
  - Responsive retro-modern receipt UI engineered with Tailwind CSS and React micro-interactions.

### 2. Shopperce AI — Multi-Tenant E-Commerce Platform
- **Live URL**: https://shopperce.ai/
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/Himanshu4234
- **Type**: Web Application (Enterprise Commerce)
- **Status**: Production / Live
- **Summary**: Scalable multi-tenant e-commerce system that enables enterprise partners to spin up branded, configurable storefronts.
- **Key Architecture & Features**:
  - Dynamic route and theme configuration loading brand tokens at runtime.
  - Reusable, WCAG-compliant UI components across partner storefronts.
  - Rich seller admin dashboard with charts for sales metrics, inventory management, and customer behavior.

### 3. LiveLaw — Legal Journalism & Intelligence Portal
- **Live URL**: https://www.livelaw.in/
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/Himanshu4234
- **Type**: Web Application (High-Traffic Media)
- **Status**: Production / Live
- **Summary**: India’s premier legal reporting platform serving 1M+ active monthly readers, lawyers, and judges.
- **Key Architecture & Features**:
  - Sub-second Largest Contentful Paint (LCP) and zero layout shift on article-dense pages.

  - High-traffic SEO schema integration maximizing Google News and Search impressions.
